classification: narrow MAC-only canonical-installer source correction after validated native blocker
objective: Make the fixed no-follow limactl --version provenance measurement run in a sanitized privileged environment with a defined root-controlled non-user HOME, without weakening fixed-image identity, env scrubbing, source provenance, or macOS-only containment.
required_invariants: Retain env -i and the fixed absolute limactl_path selected and validated before privilege elevation.
Supply a defined root-controlled, non-user-writable HOME for only the privileged limactl --version probe; do not forward caller HOME or ambient configuration.
Prefer /var/empty if validated as the exact root-controlled empty home; any different choice requires review evidence proving equal or stronger isolation.
Keep the privileged PATH fixed to /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin.
Do not change Lima selection, endpoints, instance names, transports, principals, Keychain/XPC, pairing, lifecycle semantics, or non-macOS behavior.
Add deterministic behavioral regression that fails on the exact base when HOME is absent and proves ambient/user HOME is not inherited.
Retain the amendment-0040 installer target-output contract and amendment-0041 installer-start PATH contract unchanged.

conditional_path_rules.tests/mac/dev_install_limactl_provenance: optional new focused regression; create only if stronger than extending the existing two fixtures
conditional_path_rules.llm-last-mile/runtime-refactor/06-review: edit only for a valid accepted P3/P4 finding with stable ID and evidence; otherwise byte-identical

prohibited_actions: any path outside the authorized fence
running the canonical installer against the real prefix or mutating /Library, Keychain, launchd, Lima, sudoers, or known_hosts
official evidence execution or artifact mutation
Windows/WSL or ordinary Linux behavior changes
generic environment forwarding, caller HOME, alternate limactl, wrapper/substitution, endpoint, selector, or transport
reset, clean, rebase, protected-checkout mutation, task/worktree archival, MAC-CLOSEOUT, or successor dispatch
